official_definition: By sending two cores from your "Contractor Indra" Grandwalker Nexuses to this Spirit, during this turn, all your "Can't Attack/Block" effect can't be prevented by opposing effects. When you've done so, during this game, two opposing Spirits/Ultimates can't attack/block.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Thunder Unleash] or [Thunder Unleash: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Thunder Unleash]", "give [Thunder Unleash]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Mutates game state as specified by official effect text.
